name: Tobari Arireza
source:
An employee of Bensalem, the world's top megacorporation, one which ushered in the discovery of neo-photons.

As an elite among even the elite, he was appointed manager of Clearworld Narahama, given his talents. 

He is very famously a well-loved administrator to his citizens, but as an adamant believer in elitism, he hides his true ambitions of heartlessly ridiculing and even ostracizing those he believes to be inferior or holds different views.
